subject: Route cost attribution runbook + drilldown UX proposal
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Anika Shah <anika@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Dunn <mdunn@bigbank.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Route cost attribution runbook + drilldown UX proposal

Hi all —

Posting an initial proposal for how we can land a concise runbook + lightweight drilldown UX that makes per-route cost attribution actionable for product and SRE teams. Goal: give customers (and our internal CS/AE teams) a fast path to understand "who's driving cost" for a tenant and the top candidate mitigations (sampling, cache, model variant).

Attachments: route-cost-runbook-v0.3.md (draft), drilldown-heatmap-prototype.png

Key ideas in the doc (TL;DR)
- Attribution model: primary attribution by route + secondary slice by tenant/route-variation (e.g., long context, streaming).
- UX: single-click drilldown from route-list to a heatmap showing token-cost density and tail-latency hotspots. Hover shows sample calls.
- Runbook: triage checklist (isolate tenant, check sampling, check KV cache hit rate, fallback model). Playbook maps to run severity and suggested mitigations.

Asks
1) Jasmine — can you validate the data points we need from telemetry (fields + cardinality) so the heatmap is feasible without huge query cost?
2) Soojin/Marissa — can your teams review the mock and give one high-priority omission or an MVP cut we can ship in 2 sprints?
3) Anika/Marcus — would this level of breakdown address your exec ask about transparent cost drivers for Q4? Any blind spots we should cover?

Proposed next steps: 30-min whiteboard session this week to align on instrumentation + MVP scope. I can own the runbook doc updates.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Product Manager, Console
Redwood Inference

From: Anika Shah <anika@acmecorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Route cost attribution runbook + drilldown UX proposal

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear doc. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- For "tenant/route-variation" attribution, we need the ability to group by API key and by model-variant (we use variant pins for A/B). Will that be captured?
- Heatmap: can the hover show aggregate token counts *and* an example payload (anonymized)? That helps our finance and product teams understand burst patterns.

We can join a whiteboard session — Wed or Thu afternoon PST works.

Best,
Anika
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Corp

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Anika Shah <anika@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Route cost attribution runbook + drilldown UX proposal

Thanks Jordan — read the doc and left inline comments in the Google doc link. High-level reactions:

- Telemetry table: we can capture the required fields but need to cap cardinality for the "example payload" on the heatmap (masking + sample-size = 1k rows/day per tenant default).
- Aggregation windows: suggest 1h/24h/7d on the heatmap; compute offline nightly to keep the dashboard snappy.
- MVP scope (what we can realistically commit to in 2 sprints):
  * Collect per-request cost attribution fields (api_key, model_variant, token_count, kv_hit)
  * Produce a precomputed 1h heatmap tile and a drill CSV for on-demand export
  * Add a runbook panel with checkboxes and quick links (sampling toggle, cache flush)

I'll schedule a 30-min whiteboard for Thu 11/12 10:00 PST and add an agenda.

Jasmine Liu
Sr. Product Engineer, Console
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Route cost attribution runbook + drilldown UX proposal — alignment and next steps

Following our whiteboard: quick summary and owner map.

Decisions we landed on:
- Instrumentation: collect api_key, model_variant, total_tokens, prompt/response_token_breakdown, kv_cache_hit (boolean). Sampling: default to 1% full-payload capture with a config toggle per-tenant.
- Heatmap: precompute hourly tiles (1h/24h/7d) and store as lightweight aggregates. Hover shows anonymized example (first 120 chars).
- Runbook: two severity classes (High cost: >2x baseline, Tail latency: p99 > 1s). Recommended mitigations mapped to play actions in Console.

Owners and milestones:
- Jasmine: telemetry schema and precompute job (ETA: 2 weeks)
- Soojin: UX mocks and dashboard integration (ETA: 2 sprints)
- Jordan: runbook edits and external comms (ETA: end of week)
- Marissa (me): QA/ops acceptance and JIRA tickets (JIRA-OPS-2197 created)

Post-its / open questions
- Export: external customers requested CSV export of drill data — need compliance review for payload sampling.
- Cost model: we need a short doc mapping token counts -> dollars for the UI (Jordan to draft).

I'll attach the final whiteboard snapshot and update the runbook draft in the linked Doc. If no objections, we'll start implementation Monday and loop in CS for early previews.

Attachments: route-cost-runbook-v0.3.md, drilldown-heatmap-prototype.png

Marissa Cole
Head of Console Product Operations
Redwood Inference
